cohort: This study included 500 postnatal mothers admitted to the postnatal ward of a rural hospital between June 2021 and January 2022.
finding: Cesarean delivery and primiparity were associated with a lower proportion of breastfeeding initiation, although the number increased during the next 24 hours.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a lower proportion of breastfeeding initiation, although the number increased during the next 24 hours.
